## Document or section

## Expected outcome
How will this help users, contributors, or maintainers?

## Contribution program
- [ ] NSoC Winter Edition 2026
- [ ] ECSOC 2026
- [ ] ELUSOC 2026
- [ ] General contribution

For NSoC-focused issues, maintainers may use the `[NSoC_2026]` title prefix as a repository convention. Follow the current official program guidance for required registration and tracking; this title prefix is not represented as an official NSoC rule.

## Checklist
